ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.source_inter != :viu_block.source_inter or
 :global.exist_inter != :viu_block.exist_inter or
 :global.action_inter != :viu_block.action_inter then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05',
 :global.source_inter||','||
 :global.exist_inter||','||
 :global.action_inter||
 ',','D',chk);
 end if;
-- message('in dup check');pause;
IF :global.source_inter = :viu_block.source_inter and
 :global.exist_inter = :viu_block.exist_inter and
 :global.action_inter = :viu_block.action_inter 
THEN
 null;
ELSE 
 if :viu_block.source_inter is not null and
 :viu_block.exist_inter is not null and
 :viu_block.action_inter is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_inter_upgrades
 WHERE source_inter = :viu_block.source_inter and
 exist_inter = :viu_block.exist_inter and
 action_inter = :viu_block.action_inter;
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05',
 :viu_block.source_inter||','||
 :viu_block.exist_inter||','||
 :viu_block.action_inter||
 ',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05C05',
 :viu_block.source_inter||','||
 :viu_block.exist_inter||','||
 :viu_block.action_inter||
 ',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.SOURCE_INTER' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.source_inter',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.EXIST_INTER' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.exist_inter',action);
 end if;
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_new_inter',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_exist_inter',action); 
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_new_inter',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_exist_inter',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETREIVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retreive_data IS
chk boolean;
begin
if :ctrl_block.source_inter is null
 then
 if :ctrl_block.exist_inter is null 
 then
 null;
 else 
 set_block_property('viu_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'exist_inter = :ctrl_block.exist_inter');
 end if;
 else 
 if :ctrl_block.exist_inter is null 
 then
 set_block_property('viu_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'source_inter = :ctrl_block.source_inter'); 
 else 
 set_block_property('viu_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'source_inter = :ctrl_block.source_inter and
 exist_inter = :ctrl_block.exist_inter');
 end if;
end if; 

go_block('viu_block');
execute_query;
set_block_property('viu_block',DEFAULT_WHERE,'');
go_block('viu_block');

end;
